title: ci(shard-timings-refresh): push and open the refresh PR as the fleet App so it runs CI
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D4WbEC4Xfs3EygKcaDSqinr)_

Part of #25936. The card stays open for two readings this PR cannot take before it merges (see "What stays open").

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**：每周一自动刷新 Test Core 分片计时数据的 workflow（`shard-timings-refresh.yml`），推分支、开 PR、打标签这三步改用 fleet App（`objectstack-fleet[bot]`）的身份做。令牌在 runner 上现铸，只对本仓、只给 contents 和 pull-requests 两项写权限，用完即吊销。job 自己的 `GITHUB_TOKEN` 降为只读。

**为什么改**：以前用 Actions 自带的 `GITHUB_TOKEN` 开 PR（仓里没有配 `RELEASE_PUSH_TOKEN`），GitHub 对这种 PR 不启动任何 CI。结果每次刷新 PR 都要有人手动推一下才有检查：#24467 等了十天，今天的 #25960 是席位用中继 `pr_update_branch` 才跑起来的。刷新会改变分片切法，恰恰最需要 CI 读一遍。

**风险与代价（含回滚）**：用的是 fleet-write 已在用的那对组织级凭据（`OS_FLEET_APP_ID` / `OS_FLEET_PRIVATE_KEY`），不引入 PAT。凭据不可见时这一步直接报红并点名缺哪一半，不会悄悄退回无 CI 的老路。PR 上跑这个 workflow 时照旧是演练，不铸令牌、不读密钥。回滚就是 revert 这一个文件。ui/ 的逐文件计时数据集这次没接上（见下文），它由 #25712 第 5 项承接。

**席位意见**：

**你要做的**：本 PR 是 Tier H（`.github/workflows/**`），需要一位 GOVERNED_APPROVERS 批准；批准后席位落地。

## What changed

`.github/workflows/shard-timings-refresh.yml` only (+78 / −24):

- **Two new steps before the write step**, both skipped on `pull_request` and when the dataset is byte-identical:
  - `Check the fleet App credential is visible to this repository` reads `vars.OS_FLEET_APP_ID` and `secrets.OS_FLEET_PRIVATE_KEY` as booleans (never printed) and reds with a message naming the missing half.
  - `Mint the fleet App token, narrowed to this repository`: `actions/create-github-app-token@v3`, the same action and credential pair `fleet-write.yml` mints with, and the route ui/'s refresh took in objectstack-ai/objectui#13362. The grants are `contents: write` (push the bot branch) and `pull-requests: write` (open the PR, add `skip-changeset`). It has no `workflows` grant, because the branch is cut from the checked-out `main` plus one commit touching only the dataset.
- **Write step**: `GH_TOKEN` is the minted token on a live run and the run's read-only token on a `pull_request` dry run, where `outward` hands it to nothing. A live run with no minted token arrives empty and the existing `GH_TOKEN:?` guard reds it. `outward gh auth setup-git` points git at that token for the push. The commit author is now `objectstack-fleet[bot]`.
- **Job permissions** drop from `contents: write` + `pull-requests: write` + `actions: read` to `contents: read` + `actions: read`. The checkout uses `persist-credentials: false` and no longer reads `RELEASE_PUSH_TOKEN`.
- **PR body**: the "No checks will start on this PR by themselves" section and its `USED_PAT` switch are gone. It is replaced by one line saying the PR was opened as the fleet App and runs its own CI (the card's step 3).

## The measurement this rests on

1. **The root refresh has the card's no-CI defect.** #25960 (2026-10-26 05:47Z) is authored by `github-actions[bot]`, and its body carries the `USED_PAT != true` section, so `RELEASE_PUSH_TOKEN` is not configured. It got CI only after a relay `pr_update_branch`. #24467 (2026-10-19) sat ten days the same way.
2. **The ui/ per-file dataset has no producer.** `ui/.github/workflows/test-shard-timings-refresh.yml` is nested, so GitHub never runs it. Root `ci.yml`'s `Test UI (N/16)` passes no timings reporter and uploads no `test-file-timings-N` artifact, and its own comment says so: the port belongs to the governance-workflow audit. That audit is #25712 item 5, which names `test-shard-timings-refresh` among the workflows to fold into the objectstack counterpart and widen to `ui/**`. #25712 is in flight under another seat's claim, so this PR does not build that half. The dataset today: `ui/scripts/test-shard-timings.json` was measured 2026-10-19T06:37Z over 6 runs and holds 5,547 keys. Of the 5,805 tracked `*.test.*` files under `ui/` (excluding `e2e/` and `apps/site/`), 290 have no key and are weighed at the median, and 32 keys name files that no longer exist. That count is from `git ls-files` and is an upper bound on what vitest collects.

## Verification

Head `cadda147` (`50d4fffd` plus a merge of `origin/main` `a3e5bfa6`, no conflict; this PR's diff against `main` is the one file).

- **The write step, driven as written.** Its `run:` block was lifted out of the YAML and run under `bash -e` in a scratch repository:
  - Dry leg (`DRY_RUN=true`, `pull_request`, stand-in `GH_TOKEN`): exit 0. Every outward act printed `DRY RUN, not executed:`, including `gh auth setup-git`. The local commit was authored `objectstack-fleet[bot]`, email `332303061+objectstack-fleet[bot]@users.noreply.github.com`.
  - Live leg with an empty `GH_TOKEN` (a run where minting did not happen): exit 1 at the guard, `GH_TOKEN: is not set; gh would run unauthenticated. Nothing was pushed.`
- **The credential check, three legs.** Both set: exit 0, and it writes `repository=objectstack`. App id missing: exit 1. Key missing: exit 1.
- **Derived gates**: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 42 families. All 42 ran locally with exit 0, including `select-shard-timings-run.mjs --self-test` (it lifts and runs this workflow's selection step), `measure-test-shard-timings.mjs --self-test`, `partition-test-shards.mjs --self-test`, `check-step-collectors`, `check-whole-set-label-write`, `check-workflow-step-name-quoting` and `check:pm-dispatch-gates` (fast tier, 1917 cases). `--ran` reconciled: 42 run, 0 NOT MEASURED.
- **This PR's own `pull_request` run of the lane** (the path filter includes the workflow) executes everything up to and including the write step's local commit, with the new `env:`. That is the on-runner proof of the dry leg; read it on the PR's checks.
- `check-governed-merges --branch HEAD`: GOVERNED, `.github/workflows/**`, Tier H, 102 changed lines.

## What stays open on the card

- **The acceptance reading.** The first live refresh after this lands must show check runs on its PR within 10 minutes, with no human push. That is the next Monday cron (2026-11-02 05:30Z), or sooner through a relay `workflow_dispatch` of `shard-timings-refresh.yml` at `main`.
- **The ui/ dataset half.** #25712 item 5 carries it (fold the ui refresh into this lane). #25936 remains open until the seat records how that lands.

## Acceptance notes

- `cut-rc.yml` makes the same "PAT if present, Actions token otherwise" choice for the release-candidate PR. It is out of scope for this card and is noted only, not filed.
- No changeset: this PR changes a workflow, which publishes nothing (`skip-changeset`).
